scientific_integrity: Exact continuous-parameter proof by positive Laplace-convolution representation. Numeric event-driven simulation is only supplementary. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proof assumes one-dimensional harmonic linear response, an irreducible three-state motor, fair independent direction redrawing after exponentially distributed tumbles, stationary initial law and independent additive thermal diffusion. Claim is mixed motor/position time-asymmetry, not position-only irreversibility or entropy production. Publication priority is qualified by inaccessible indexed full-text and unindexed equivalent-work risk.
title: A one-sided motility–energy time arrow in finite-tumble harmonic transport
